newsitem.title: INDIA: Death toll in Indian firecracker blast rises to 12.
newsitem.headline: Death toll in Indian firecracker blast rises to 12.

text.p: The death toll in an explosion at a firecracker factory in southern India last week has risen to 12, the Press Trust of India said on Sunday.
The explosion occured on Thursday at the factory in the southern state of Tamil Nadu when a firecracker caught fire while it was being made.
Five people were declared dead on Thursday after initial reports said 14 had died.
The explosion took place at Sivakasi, a town some 500 km (312 miles) south of Madras, the state capital.
Sivakasi is a major manufacturing centre for firecrackers and matches in India.
